feeds.title: Charise Jewell
feeds.description: Hi. I'm Charise. I'm a mom, writer, and robotics engineer. I was diagnosed with bipolar disorder in 2017. It was devastating. My book, Crazy, Memoir of a Mom Gone Mad, is about denial, recovery, and stigma.

feeds.title: Fabric Engineer
feeds.description: I have an M.S. in engineering and have worked in several different fields. I currently live in Western Michigan, have two small children, and am an adjunct professor at a local college.

feeds.title: The Engineered Mama
feeds.description: I'm a mom who happens to be an engineer. I love taking care of our little men, our home, cooking, shopping, and clothes. I have a job that my five-year-old self would never have dreamed would exist someday. I love anything that makes my life easier and saves time and money in the process and love sharing what might help someone else.

feeds.title: Saroy
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Sarah Ruiz, a quilter and aerospace engineer living in Houston, Texas. I've been sharing slices of my life online since the late 1990s so this ol' blog covers a lot of ground, from 20-year-old college student to 40+ years old and married with kids! It's currently home to my quilting work, snippets of family life, and occasional musings on my engineering career.

feeds.title: Chief Mom Officer
feeds.description: I'm a breadwinning mom to three wonderful active boys (13, 9, and 1 1/2), with a stay at home husband. I want to help working moms everywhere take control of their financial, working, and family life, and reach their dreams-whatever those might be.

feeds.title: Momgineering the Future
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kristen. I am an engineer by trade, a writer by love, and a wife and mother by fate. I feel that it is so important for parents and educators to expose children to a variety of STEAM activities, books, events, and careers as young as possible to prime their interest and build their confidence! I hope to inspire parents and educators alike and offer insight into some unique opportunities!

feeds.title: Mom Can Fix Anything
feeds.description: I am a proud mom of two teenage boys, a lucky wife, and a Network Engineer, Consultant, Instructor, and Juniper Ambassador. What I have always liked the most during my career is learning new things and sharing what I have learned with others. I enjoy figuring out the best way to present information, and I LOVE answering technical questions. I created this page as a new way to share technical knowledge with other people.

feeds.title: Story of a Mom, Motherhood & Beyond...
feeds.description: Hi, I am Gunjan, the founder of this blog Tuggu n mommy A coffee addict mom of a hyperactive toddler #Little Tuggu. I am an Engineer with MBA and have a passion for creativity and writing. Through this blog, I aim to share my Story as a mom and beyond.

feeds.title: Engineer Mommy
feeds.description: Engineer Mommy is a digital magazine dedicated to creating realistic, engaging lifestyle content that helps people live better, happier, and more purpose-filled lives. Jennifer loves to share beauty, fashion, parenting, storytelling & lifestyle content.

feeds.title: Homeschool Momgineer
feeds.description: I'm an engineer turned stay-at-home mom. After working as an engineer for over 10 years, I finally made the leap to stay home to raise our 3 rambunctious boys. But once an engineer, always an engineer. Now I teach my sons about the world through my eyes, the eyes of an engineer.

feeds.title: Start a Mom Blog
feeds.description: Six years ago I started this little website to help other moms with the tech and strategy behind growing a successful blog. This website was created specifically for moms who want to learn how to start and grow their blogs. If that's you, you're in the right place!
